subject_identity_preserved.rationale: A single adult elephant remains the central wildlife subject across all shots, with broadly consistent gray skin, tusks, and calm behavior. Some cuts change scale and pose abruptly, especially from shot 2 to shot 3, but they read as viewpoint changes rather than a clear subject swap.

background_coherent.rationale: The savanna setting, golden grass, acacia trees, distant hills, cloudy sky, and safari-vehicle framing persist through most shots. Coherence weakens in the close-up shots where foliage density and vehicle bars conflict with captions claiming no artificial structures, but the place still appears continuous.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Matches the safari-vehicle view, savanna, acacia trees, distant elephant, and warm documentary tone well.
Filmmaker, mounted camera, vehicle frame, distant elephant, and savanna are all present; elephant appears more standing than actively grazing.
Elephant and savanna match, but vehicle bars remain visible despite the caption specifying no human interference and a more open natural view.

Close elephant view fits, but prominent vehicle bars/window framing contradict the caption's claim of no artificial structures and the described low-angle upward reveal is not evident in the sampled frame.
Elephant close-up is appropriate, but vehicle bars and a mounted microphone/rig are prominent despite the caption specifying no human presence or artificial structure.
Frontal elephant in savanna fits, but vehicle elements remain visible and the described wide, unobstructed landscape is partially compromised.
Elephant, safari-vehicle perspective, red strap, photographer, and savanna match the caption well, though the man appears more side/back-view than clearly smiling in profile.
Elephant walking toward camera in savanna fits, but visible vehicle/human elements contradict the caption's no-human-infrastructure framing.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: The sequence preserves meaningful variation: distant observation, filmmaker view, medium elephant view, tight close-ups, wider frontal approach, and vehicle-perspective shots with human presence. It does not collapse into repeated identical compositions.

motion_continuity.rationale: The elephant plausibly changes position and scale, moving from lateral distant walking to close proximity and then frontal approach. The motion is somewhat jumpy across cuts but not frozen or static.

which_cut_broke.how: The transition from shot 2 to shot 3 is the most abrupt: a medium/distant elephant behind vehicle framing jumps to an extreme close frontal elephant pressed near the vehicle/window. It is still plausibly the same event, but this is the weakest continuity point.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames show varied camera distances, compositions, human/equipment inclusion, and elephant poses. There is no obvious copied-frame or frozen-sequence behavior.
